notice.title: Legal notice
notice.body1: This website is for informational purposes only and allows service requests subject to operational review and manual confirmation.
notice.body2: The information presented may change without prior notice depending on operational availability.
notice.contactBody: Please use this website’s form to get in touch.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body1: Data provided through the form is used solely to manage your transfer request and the communications necessary to handle it.
privacy.body2: We may use measurement and advertising tools, such as Google Ads, to understand site activity and measure the effectiveness of our campaigns. These tools may process technical browser information and interactions with the website according to their own policies.
privacy.purposeBody: To manage transfer or reservation requests, respond to related inquiries, and coordinate the communications necessary to provide the service.
privacy.legalBasisBody: The consent given by the data subject when submitting the form.
privacy.retentionBody: Data will be retained for as long as necessary to manage the request and the related communications, unless a different legal obligation applies.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, rectification or deletion in accordance with applicable regulations, using this website’s form.
privacy.securityBody: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are applied to protect data against unauthorized access.

cookies.title: Cookies policy
cookies.body1: This website may use measurement and advertising technologies, including Google tags, to measure visits, interactions and conversions associated with our campaigns.
cookies.body2: These technologies may use cookies, identifiers or local browser storage. When required, consent will be requested before activating non-essential advertising or measurement purposes.
cookies.body3: Language preferences may be stored locally in the browser to improve the browsing experience.
